projects.name: Agent Skills Bundle
projects.description: Personal, cross-harness **AI agent skill bundle** for **OpenCode** and **Claude Code**, vendoring four upstream open-source skill repositories pinned by commit SHA in a **YAML** manifest. Built **Bash**/**Python** validation tooling (manifest schema, frontmatter grammar, duplicate-name and broken-link checks) wired into **GitLab CI**, plus a scheduled upstream-sync pipeline that opens review-gated merge requests, **git-cliff** changelogs, and SemVer releases. Includes an original **seven-phase, human-gated feature workflow** skill orchestrating exploration, research, requirements, spec, plan, adversarial review, and implementation across both harnesses.

projects.name: GH Release Notify
projects.description: Long-running **Rust daemon** that polls a configurable list of GitHub repositories for new stable releases and sends plain-text email notifications via **SMTP**. Built on the **Tokio** async runtime and **reqwest**, with a fixed-interval or cron schedule, atomic JSON state to avoid duplicate alerts and retry on SMTP failure, optional GitHub token for higher rate limits, and graceful shutdown. Ships as a multi-arch **Docker/podman** container published to GHCR, with a **GitHub Actions** release pipeline and automated SemVer versioning from conventional commits.

projects.name: Digital Signature POC
projects.description: Full-stack proof-of-concept implementing secure **client-side ECDSA digital signing** for trade recommendations. Features a zero-knowledge security model where **private keys never leave the client unencrypted**, using **Web Crypto API** for key generation and **AES-GCM encryption** with **PBKDF2 key derivation**. Includes complete key rotation workflow while maintaining historical signature verification.

projects.name: SplitDuo
projects.description: A lightweight, open-source, **self-hosted** expense-splitting app written in **.NET 10** with **EF Core 10** (backend) and **Nuxt 4** / **Vue 3** / **Nuxt UI v4** / **TypeScript** (frontend), backed by **PostgreSQL 17** and deployed as a single **Docker** container. SplitDuo is a no-subscription alternative to Splitwise and Cospend: **AI receipt scanning** via any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (bring your own key), settlement-aware balances that minimize the number of transfers, subgroup "alias mode," **Quartz**-driven recurring expenses, expense attachments, **TOTP 2FA** with backup codes, JWT auth with **rotating refresh tokens** and reuse detection, CSV import/export from Splitwise and Cospend, EN/IT email notifications, full **EN/IT i18n**, and an installable **PWA** — covered by xUnit + **Testcontainers** integration tests and a CI pipeline with security and secret-scanning gates.

projects.name: PodCats
projects.description: Self-hosted, multi-user podcast manager — but with cats. **Vue 3** / **Vuetify 3** / **Pinia** frontend backed by a **Go** (**Gin** + **GORM**) REST API on **SQLite**. Imports podcast feeds via **RSS** (**gofeed**), discovers shows through the **iTunes Search API**, and streams episodes in-browser with **Howler.js** — plus **JWT auth**, resume-listening, favorites, a **cron**-driven feed poller with in-app notifications, and global fuzzy search (**Fuse.js**). Shipped as a multi-stage **Docker** image built and published through a **GitLab CI** (**Kaniko**) pipeline.

projects.name: Private Cloud Infrastructure

Hands-on experience with **containerization**, **networking**, **security**, and **backup strategies**.
